source_hierarchy: 1. Venue's own website (most authoritative for hours, address, phone, games)
2. PokerAtlas (authoritative for table counts, stakes, tournament schedules)
3. Hendon Mob (authoritative for tournament series and events)
4. Bravo Poker Live (real-time waitlist and game info)
